name: Olive and lemon pasta
ingredients:
250 g spaghetti
3 tablespoons olive oil
1 lemon, zest and juice
80 g green olives
Black pepper
directions:
Cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Warm the oil with the lemon zest.
Toss the pasta with the oil, olives, and lemon juice.
notes: Save a cup of pasta water before draining.

name: Pear breakfast oats
ingredients:
80 g rolled oats
300 ml milk
1 ripe pear
Pinch of cinnamon
directions:
Simmer the oats and milk for 6 minutes.
Grate in half the pear.
Serve with the remaining pear and cinnamon.
notes: Use oat milk for a dairy-free bowl.
